input.quote: For the acceptance period and for a period of one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and thereafter for as long as the Software is covered by Maintenance Services and is used by Sparkling in accordance with this Agreement, Garman warrants that the Software shall perform in conformance with the Specifications in all material respects.
input.rationale: The Software conformance warranty duration meets the preferred position (one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date and continuing while under maintenance), and there is no "AS IS" disclaimer that would swallow it. However, Section 12 states no remedy for breach: the only repair path is Garman's "best efforts" repair under the Maintenance Services (p0077), which is fee-bearing in listed cases and carries no replacement or refund backstop, and the refund/rejection right in Sections 7-8 expires with the acceptance period. Section 12 also omits a professional and workmanlike warranty for Garman's services (installation, data conversion, training, maintenance), a no-malicious-code warranty and a compliance-with-laws warranty. We inserted those warranties and an express repair, replacement or re-performance remedy with a refund if Garman fails to cure within 30 days.

proposal.summary: Add services/malicious code/compliance warranties and an express repair-replace-or-refund remedy to Section 12
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 12 warrants Software conformance for a year but gives no stated remedy and says nothing about the services, malicious code or legal compliance, so we added a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus a repair, re-performance or refund remedy. If helpful we can accept a 90-day services warranty period, but we need a real remedy for non-conforming work.

ops.text: Garman further warrants that: (a) all services performed under this Agreement, including installation, data conversion, training and the Maintenance Services, will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards by suitably qualified personnel; (b) the Software will be free of viruses, worms, disabling code and other malicious code; and (c) Garman will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. If the Software fails to conform to the warranty in this Section 12, or any services fail to conform to the warranty in (a) above, Garman shall promptly repair or replace the Software, or re-perform the affected services, at no charge to Sparkling; if Garman fails to do so within thirty (30) days of written notice, Garman shall refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Software or services.
